description: Anchor format with electrical properties (RatedCurrent, RatedVoltage, TripCount) vs. flat JSON with current_rating but also manufacturer and installation_date. Tests partial overlap where each side has unique properties.
notes: Partial overlap: Anchor side has RatedVoltage (VOLT) and TripCount which JSON side lacks. JSON side has manufacturer and installation_date which are untaggable. RatedCurrent maps to CURR.
